overall_diagnosis: All samples converge on a single issue: maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md is underspecified/ambiguous in the exact areas the organizer hint calls out—toolchain selection/validation, failure reproduction steps, and Maven command conventions (especially for Maven Wrapper usage and maven-invoker nested builds). This can cause users to reproduce builds with the wrong Maven/JDK, miss CI profiles/properties/flags, and incorrectly focus on the top-level reactor when the failing build is actually an Invoker-driven nested project.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: Guidance for toolchain selection/validation and build reproduction is present but not sufficiently prescriptive about matching CI (Maven Wrapper vs system Maven; reading .mvn/jvm.config; validating JDK via toolchains.xml/enforcer/compiler settings) and about the exact Maven command conventions to reproduce the failing scenario. It also risks being too generic (e.g., “run mvn test”) rather than directing the reader to rerun the precise CI command and, for invoker failures, the specific nested build.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Revise only the toolchain selection/validation, failure reproduction, and command-convention sections to be explicit and CI-aligned: (1) Require using ./mvnw when present and checking .mvn/jvm.config plus mvn -version output for Java/Maven; (2) Instruct to inspect/align with toolchains.xml and any maven-toolchains-plugin, maven-enforcer-plugin, and maven-compiler-plugin release/source/target settings before changing dependencies/source; (3) Add concrete command templates for reproducing (a) the top-level reactor and (b) maven-invoker nested IT builds, including capturing CI profiles/properties and safe diagnostic flags (-e/-X), and clarifying when to use -DskipTests vs invoker-specific skips/properties; (4) Emphasize reproducing the *first concrete error* in the failing nested build.log and warn against broad, ambiguous commands that diverge from CI.
